'''Vapor Station''' was a small [[canyon]] outpost that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was operated by agents of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] and lay within the territories of Sinasu's rival Hutt [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Jora]] assembled a cargo of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and a junior Krayt dragon at Vapor Station, which was to be [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] to Sinasu on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by a group of individuals who were indebted to the Hutt. However, just as Jora briefed the agents for their upcoming assignment, the outpost was raided by a band of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
